{{Quote|Wanted dead or alive for piracy against Commerce Guild transports.|Haangok's bounty brief|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''Haangok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] active in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. His several ambushes on [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] convoys yielded the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajan'sa'Nikto]] his own [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]]. While Haangok visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]'s [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] in 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the Nikto was found by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], who claimed the bounty on the pirate after defeating him. 

==Biography==
[[File:JangoFett-NEC.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jango Fett (pictured) claimed the bounty on Haangok.]]
Haangok was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="BHSG" /> The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] operated as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|4|Haangok}}</ref> in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, which includes the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], and ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> ambushed several convoys of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]].<ref name="CSWE" /> By that year,<ref name="Date" /> the guild had issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Haangok. It listed his last known location as the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and his associates as [[Realspace/Legends|space]] pirates. The payout was 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] if he was [[Death/Legends|killed]], or 4,000 credits if he was captured alive.<ref name="BH" />

After the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Haangok, accompanied by others, visited the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant. The criminal gazed at a large floating [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a dancer<ref name="BH" /> as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] identified him as wanted during his pursuit of [[Slythmonger/Legends|drug dealer]] [[Jervis Gloom]].<ref name="BH" /> Upon seeing Fett, Haangok and his companions began shooting at him,<ref name="BH" /> but Fett was able to dispatch the Nikto's companions.<ref name="BHSG" /> After tying Haangok up in his [[Whipcord launcher/Legends|whipcord]],<ref name="BH" /> the bounty hunter claimed the bounty.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Personality and traits==
Haangok had [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="BH" /> He viciously attacked Jango Fett when he was found.<ref name="BHSG" /> 

==Equipment==
During his visit to the Uscru District, the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-wielding Haangok wore a grey [[Clothing/Legends|jacket]], a red shirt, tan pants, and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="BHSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Haangok first appeared in the [[2002]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''.<ref name="BH" /> The capture of Haangok, who was the optional eleventh bounty in the entertainment district level,<ref name="BHSG" /> was confirmed in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE /> The character can also be [[Canon|non-canonically]] killed for a lower amount of credits.<ref name="BH" />
